title: Hunger Begone: Chimney Trails
description: An addon for the HungerBegone mod, adding sounds, recipes, structures, and more.
body:
# Hunger Begone: Chimney Trails

An add-on mod for [Hunger-Begone](https://modrinth.com/mod/hunger-begone)

## Features

###  Recipe Fragment Item
- When holding a fragment and right-clicking on a block, a random Hunger-Begone recipe will be displayed
- Once displayed, the recipe becomes fixed and will not change again

### Sound Enhancements
- **Placing an item in the stove**: plays the `pan_input.ogg` sound effect when inserting an item
- **Oven door open/close**: plays the iron trapdoor sound effect when opening or closing the door

### Desert Abandoned Camp
- An abandoned camp structure that naturally generates in desert biomes

### New Recipes
- Simple adaptations for vanilla food items
